dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000q52k](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000q52k) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 35.0 depth occurred on Apr 10 2025 4km E of Comoro. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -5.9376 longitude 138.6674. It impacted 18780 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
